audit_fixed: special_cases[refuse_to_talk].action changed from {close lark_no_deal/lark_refused} to {note lark_refused} (ends_call stays true): the brief only says a second refusal 'ends the call and marks all remaining products lark_refused'; the close outcome follows the section 9 precedence (it would be lark_arranged if a promise was already recorded, or lark_no_deal with the first non-settled product's reason, which may be lark_disputed etc.), so hard-coding lark_no_deal/lark_refused was not supported by the text.

audit_unresolved: No deadline or attempt rule exists for products 0 days late or more than 45 days late (only band 1-45 is defined). This is already listed in policy.unresolved.

Constraints with no IR field, kept only as prompt-level rules: what counts as holder confirmation (yes, speaking, own name; not hello or a question); a missing callback hour must be clarified, never guessed; third parties are told nothing; the hardship sympathy sentence is not dictated verbatim; the wording of the service-error message ('says it failed') is not dictated; never offer a discount, waiver or new instalment plan; never call get_account before all questions pass; use call variable now, never the machine clock.
